root_cause: When the Escape key is pressed to close the dropdown menu, the hide() method correctly updates aria-expanded and hides the menu but does not restore focus to the toggle button, leaving focus elsewhere (often on the menu item or body).
repair_strategy: Modify the dataApiKeydownHandler in dropdown.js to focus the toggle element after hiding the menu when the Escape key is handled.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape will close the invoice actions menu and return focus to the 'Invoice actions' toggle button, satisfying keyboard accessibility requirements for modal-like dropdowns.
functional_risks: Focusing the toggle after hide() may cause unexpected focus movement if hide() is invoked via other means (e.g., clicking outside) but the change is limited to the Escape key path.
If the toggle element is disabled or detached at the time of hiding, focus() will be a no‑op, which is safe.
verification_requirements: After opening the menu with ArrowDown, pressing Escape must result in aria-expanded='false' on the toggle.
After Escape, the active element must be the toggle button (#actions-toggle).
Menu navigation with ArrowUp/ArrowDown and item activation with Enter must continue to work as before.
Clicking outside the menu to close it should not alter focus behavior.
